Cited `hooks-runtime.ts:156 (PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENTS)` sits INSIDE the executor that inert-worklist §3 item 5 says not to revive: `PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENTS` is consumed only by `HOOK_EVENT_SET` (:191) → `isPluginHookEventName` (:554) → the dead registry builder. Keep `hooks-runtime.ts:25` (the union is live and imported by `hooks-automation.ts:47` and `format-adapters.ts:11`); drop `:156`.

CORRECTION 3 — line drift and an overstatement. The `addDirectories` case is at `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:3193`, not `:3189` (which is `replaced: dropped` in the preceding `replaceRules` case). Note also that our `addDirectories` arrives as a `PermissionRequest` hook's `updatedPermissions` output and is refused unless `destination === 'session'` (:3194-3199) — so the surface is real but narrower than "we add working directories mid-session"; Claude's `DirectoryAdded` fires on `/add-dir` or the `register_repo_root` control request. RESTATED FINDING: `DirectoryAdded` is a Claude Code hook event documented on `agent-sdk/hooks.md` (line 181, TypeScript SDK only — Python "No") and announced in `changelog.md:20`, absent from the main `hooks.md` reference. Our fork does not carry it in any of the three gates — `PluginHookEventName` (`hooks-runtime.ts:25-54`), `CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP` (`format-adapters.ts:123-152`), or `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS` (`:99-102`). The `28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events` comment at `format-adapters.ts:118` and the matching comment at `hooks-runtime.ts:12-13` are correct against the main hooks reference (30) but stale against the SDK roster (31). This is the new-event failure mode AGENTS.md flags. Minimum fix is one line in `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS` plus a refreshed count in both comments; full support additionally needs a union member, a map entry, and an emission point on the session-directory path.
